subject: Privatelink segmentation declaration & VPC separation — Riverton Health evidence
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@rivertonhealth.org>
To: priya.natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 21 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: VPC separation statement + residency artifacts for EU pilot

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team at Riverton is excited to move to a pilot focused on EU-only hosting. Before our security review next Wednesday, we need a short written declaration confirming:

- That Redwood can restrict production tenant traffic to EU-only nodes for a pinned model version
- That VPC/private deployment (Privatelink) instances can be deployed in our account/peering arrangement with tenant network separation
- Which keystore/escrow model you use for operator key material (HSM vs customer-managed KMS)

Could you also include a brief access-log snapshot for a non-prod tenant (redacted) and an operator manifest that shows role separation? Our Security Ops needs those artifacts to validate the SIG/CAIQ answers.

Ideal timeline: deliver by 4pm UTC on Tue so we can circulate to the reviewer.

Appreciate it — Samira

--
Samira Khan
Security Manager | Riverton Health
samira.khan@rivertonhealth.org
From: priya.natarajan@redwood.com
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@rivertonhealth.org>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 21 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: VPC separation statement + residency artifacts for EU pilot

Samira —

Thanks for the clear ask. Per request, attaching a compact evidence set:

- redwood_vpc_separation_diagram.pdf (diagram showing EU-only tenancy and privatelink peering)
- keystore_operator_manifest.csv (roles & operator keys confirmation; operator accounts are separated from customer tenant)
- residency_sig_caig_responses.xlsx (excerpted SIG/CAIQ lines relevant to regional controls)
- access-log-snapshot-20280720.json (redacted non-prod access snapshot)

Short answers inline:

1) EU-only restriction: We support EU-only production tenant routing. Customers can pin model versions and set region-routing policy; requests for that tenant are routed only to EU-hosted nodes unless fallback is explicitly enabled. We will include a signed one-page declaration if you require a legal attestation.

2) VPC/private deployment: Privatelink deployments use customer VPC peering (or AWS Privatelink depending on setup); we provide a per-tenant private endpoint and network policies that prevent cross-tenant traffic. The attached diagram shows the separation boundary.

3) Keystore model: Redwood uses a split-operator model. For Private deployments we support customer-managed KMS (recommended); for Redwood-managed Dedicated or Hosted we use HSM-backed operator keys with rotation policies. The manifest shows operator roles and rotation cadence.

Next steps: Irene (cc'd) will pull a short signed declaration and a checklist for your reviewer. If you need a DocuSign signature or additional SCAR logs, say the word.

Delivering files now.

Best,

Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: redwood_vpc_separation_diagram.pdf, keystore_operator_manifest.csv, residency_sig_caig_responses.xlsx, access-log-snapshot-20280720.json
